subject: POC Kickoff: validation plan & checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos@skylab.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff: validation plan & checklist

Hi Carlos / Anika —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and the lightweight kickoff plan we discussed so we can get a minimal validation running even if your infra team needs extra time for approvals.

What we agreed on during the call:
- Goal: validate Redwood inference latency and basic routing on a 1-week POC using a sample dataset and representative prompts.
- Success metrics: < 220ms P95 on our sandbox for 512-token prompts; basic output fidelity on the included test prompts.
- Minimal infra requirements: outbound access to api.redwood-inference.com (whitelisted IPs provided below) and S3 read access for the sample dataset.

Attachments: poc-setup-checklist.pdf (setup steps), redwood-sandbox-guide.md (how to use our hosted sandbox).

Two paths to keep momentum (pick one):
1) Fast path (recommended) — we configure a temporary sandbox in our hosted environment. No infra changes needed on your side. We provide a short mapping doc and sample scripts. Estimated time: <2 hours to get started.
2) On-prem-lite — we send a minimal Docker image you can run behind your network. Requires a small firewall rule and short infra window (~4 hours).

Next steps / asks from your side:
- Please confirm which path you prefer and whether the security/infra team is available for a short 30-minute window this week.
- If you want us to loop in your infra/security contact directly, reply-all with their email and we’ll send a tailored checklist.

We’ve included a short checklist and the sandbox guide as attachments. If it’s easier, I can propose two times for a quick 30-minute setup window.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a quick validation.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

--
Attachments: poc-setup-checklist.pdf (3 pages) — minimal commands and firewall rules; redwood-sandbox-guide.md (1 page).

Thanks Carlos — totally understood and thank you for the update. Quick replies below and a lightweight fallback plan if security needs more time.

Answers to your two asks:
- Whitelist: api.redwood-inference.com (TCP 443) and these IPs: 35.214.10.22, 35.214.10.23, 35.214.10.24. I’ve also added a short description you can paste into the ticket (attached as infra-deps.xlsx).
- On-prem-lite: the image can be pulled from our registry (requires outbound access once). We can also provide an offline tarball if outbound is impossible — that requires an SFTP transfer but we’ve done it for other customers.

If security would prefer a low-friction validation while the questionnaire completes, two immediate options:
A) Sandbox smoke test (no infra changes): we run a short, read-only workload against our hosted sandbox and share results + sample outputs. No whitelist needed; you consume results over a secured report. Time: 1 business day.
B) Staged on-prem pull: we provide the image tarball and a short checklist for a security review. Time: 2–3 business days for transfer + validation.

If you’re happy with A, we can run the smoke test this week and share a short report so security can see real outputs before approving network changes. If A sounds useful I’ll schedule it and Aditya will run the smoke tests and attach the results.

Proposed next step: Reply with A or B and any preferred time windows. If helpful, I can also open a Jira ticket on your behalf with the checklist to speed security review.

Thanks again — we want to make this as low-friction as possible to keep momentum.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
